title: Aberdeen亚太权益资产主管：中国互联网AI投入短期承压，长期结构性机会显现
speaker: Pukesai

segments.en: It's both at this point, but we do think that, you know, given where the Chinese valuation is, it is a structural opportunity as well.
segments.zh: 目前两者兼有，但考虑到中国市场的估值水平，我们认为这也是一个结构性机会。

segments.en: I mean, I think the China Internet names, for example, the AI plays are going through a pretty volatile time.
segments.zh: 比如中国互联网企业，尤其是AI相关标的，正经历一段波动较大的时期。

segments.en: We have seen quite a fair bit of self-off post-earning seasons from Tencent and Alibaba as well.
segments.zh: 腾讯和阿里巴巴在财报季之后也出现了不少抛售。

segments.en: As what you are seeing with these companies is that they are using the free cash flow to really accelerate their investment in AI KPEX for future growth.
segments.zh: 这些公司正利用自由现金流加速AI资本开支，为未来增长布局。

segments.en: And I think what's interesting behind that is that we are seeing better payback periods as well from the KPEX they are making as they are able to start monetizing their cloud revenue and earning higher margins.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，这些资本开支的回报周期在改善，因为他们开始将云业务收入变现，利润率也在提升。

segments.en: But I think at this point what we are seeing is that investors don't really like the story that you are using your free cash flow to actually seeing that short-term impact on their earnings.
segments.zh: 但目前投资者似乎不太认可这种用自由现金流投入、短期影响盈利的做法。

segments.en: And that, I think, represents an interesting opportunity for us, and I do think that is a fair bit of a contrarian call for us at this point in time as well.
segments.zh: 这反而为我们提供了有趣的入场机会，我认为当前时点这是一个相当逆向的观点。
